title: Why Agent Testing Is Different
description: Multi-step, non-deterministic, tool-using — none of that fits a normal test suite.

title: Task Success Evals
description: Measuring whether an agent achieved the goal, not whether it matched an exact output.

title: Simulating Tool Failures
description: Testing what an agent does when the world doesn't cooperate.

title: Cost & Latency as Quality Metrics
description: A correct agent that costs €50 per task or takes 10 minutes isn't actually usable.

title: Continuous Evaluation
description: Running evals automatically on every change, so regressions get caught before users find them.
